candidate.content: In a kitchen environment with multiple storage units, saltshakers are likely to be found inside closed cabinets. The search strategy involves systematically visiting and opening cabinets (e.g., cabinet_6, cabinet_5, cabinet_2) until the target object is revealed.
candidate.scope: Target acquisition phase for 'saltshaker' in a standard ALFRED/TextWorld kitchen setting.

direct_grounding.semantic_fact: Opening cabinet_2 reveals saltshaker_1, confirming that the target object was located within a closed cabinet.
The agent successfully executes 'take saltshaker_1 from cabinet_2', completing the acquisition of the target object.
Opening cabinet_6 reveals dishsponge_1 but no saltshaker, demonstrating that not all cabinets contain the target and requiring continued search.
Opening cabinet_5 reveals nothing, further illustrating the need to check multiple containers when the location is unknown.

minimal_global_context: The task requires placing a saltshaker on a drawer, necessitating the prior identification and retrieval of the saltshaker.
Cabinets in this environment can be either open or closed; closed ones require an 'open' action before contents are visible or accessible.
